example.context: Standard published admission for children aged two and five plus one adult before food and extras. Confirm checkout. Unknown, conflicting, stale and non-comparable totals are excluded from budget results.

venues.name: Nixon’s Farm Play Barn
venues.price: Operator snapshots conflict: £6 or £10 per child; booking service starts at £2 but does not identify the adult tariff.
venues.booking: Online booking advised; check daily sessions and current availability.
venues.features: Bouncy castles, climbing frames and soft play in a farm setting.
venues.pick: Local active play with a tea room and animals nearby.
venues.caution: Booking wording is inconsistent. Outdoor garden normally closes November–April (operator contact page). Confirm indoor ticket and adult fee before paying.
venues.parent: Tea room; seating nearby; parking/changing/noise not assessed
venues.access: Socks required; wheelchair, accessible WC and quieter sessions not confirmed
venues.review: A 31 August 2026 TripAdvisor report criticised upkeep of the play barn; other reviews on the same page are about the farm shop or café. Insufficient comparable play-specific reviews.
venues.priceNote: Two child tickets £12 or £20 depending on the tariff; adult charge and final checkout unresolved.

venues.name: Head Over Heels Wilmslow
venues.ages: Baby and toddler areas; older children under 1.55m (check height)
venues.booking: Book ahead; walk-ins subject to space
venues.features: Large frame, separate toddler area, pretend-play village, baby sensory room and disco.
venues.pick: Broadest documented range of play types within SK8 in this guide.
venues.caution: Two official 90-minute tariffs conflict. Under 1.55m to play; toddler zone ages 3 and under; cashless. Bring socks or tights; extra rides and overstays cost extra.
venues.parent: Restaurant, playside seating, Wi-Fi; two car parks, extra weekend parking; changing not assessed
venues.access: Disabled parking advertised; separate baby sensory room is not a SEND session; other access details unconfirmed
venues.review: One July 2026 Tripadvisor reviewer reported weekday parking difficulty; the venue responded with details of its two regular car parks and weekend overflow. This is an individual report, not an overall review judgement.
venues.priceNote: Two operator pages disagree for a 90-minute visit: £29.88 or £34.15 (ages 2 and 5 plus adult). Confirm selected session at checkout.

venues.name: Wild Things
venues.price: Operator about-page snapshots list child prices of £7.50 or £9.50 and £2 per adult; another directory lists £8.50.
venues.features: Large soft-play frame and Cafe Orinoco.
venues.pick: A conventional soft-play outing close to Cheadle Hulme.
venues.caution: Price sources and cached versions disagree. Ask the operator for the current family total, opening and session duration before setting off.
venues.parent: Café and table service; operator describes views and large car park; changing/noise unassessed
venues.access: Access and sensory sessions not confirmed; socks required
venues.review: Three undated Google review extracts syndicated by Soft Play Finder differ on staff and cleaning; two liked the play or café. Not a representative or dated sample.
venues.priceNote: £17–£21 for two children and one adult across conflicting operator snapshots; not a confirmed current tariff.

venues.name: Let Loose
venues.features: Main frame with elevated football area and obstacles, plus separate Toddler Town.
venues.pick: Mixed ages who want a larger frame and separate toddler space.
venues.caution: Arcade, go-karts and bear-making can cost extra; not for older teens.
venues.parent: Restaurant; seating sightlines, changing, parking and noise not assessed
venues.access: Toddler sensory equipment listed; specific SEND sessions/step-free access not confirmed
venues.review: January and February 2026 Tripadvisor reports differed on cleanliness and staff. One praised activities and food; another liked the main frame but had reservations about toddler facilities. Check recent reviews.
venues.priceNote: Published standard admission for ages 2 and 5 plus one adult; confirm booking and compulsory extras.

venues.name: Jump Heaven
venues.ages: Active children; check rules for little ones
venues.price: £15 online per child for 1 hour; 5 and under includes non-jumping adult
venues.features: Trampolines, climbing wall, slides and airbags.
venues.pick: For energetic children who want more than a standard frame.
venues.caution: Confirm one-adult supervision rules for your children's ages and any sock or adult ticket costs before booking.
venues.parent: Café; operator FAQ lists around 100 car spaces and disabled parking. Sightlines, toilets/changing and noise unassessed.
venues.access: Ask about individual access needs and session adjustments
venues.review: Recent Tripadvisor reviews examined include complaints about café cleanliness and supervision/payment confusion in 2025–26. These are reported experiences, not verified inspection findings. Confirm supervision rules before booking.
venues.priceNote: Two £15 child tickets. New grip socks £3 each if needed; confirm adult supervision for both under-sixes and whether an extra adult/ticket is required. £36–£39 with 2–3 new pairs, before any additional adult ticket.

venues.name: Run of the Mill
venues.address: Pear Mill Industrial Estate, Stockport Road, SK6 2BP
venues.features: Baby zone for crawlers, ball pool, trampolines and slides.
venues.pick: Useful for siblings of different ages; weekday admission is lower.
venues.caution: Published weekend example £20; weekday page lists £7 per child and a small adult charge with ambiguous wording. Confirm weekday total, opening and session length.
venues.parent: Café; seating, parking, changing and noise not assessed
venues.access: Dedicated 7–11 month zone; access and sensory provision unconfirmed
venues.review: Five dated Tripadvisor reviews from February 2024 to April 2026 differed on upkeep and value. The April 2026 reviewer reported improvements under new ownership but disliked adult and baby charges. Ownership change is a reader report, not independently verified.

venues.priceNote: Published standard admission for ages 2 and 5 plus one adult; confirm booking and compulsory extras.

venues.name: Tumble Jacks
venues.price: 0–9 months free; 10–11 months £3.59; ages 1–3 £8.50; age 4+ £10; adults free.
venues.features: Indoor soft play, Tumble Town imaginative playroom and café. Adults free; no fixed session end.
venues.pick: A strong value/time choice and convenient if you dislike booking.
venues.caution: Check social updates for private hire or changed opening hours; older children may want more challenge.
venues.parent: Café; seating, parking, changing and ordinary noise not assessed
venues.access: Dedicated SEN sessions advertise dimmed lighting, music off and a music-free disco room; see operator timetable. Step-free access and accessible WC unconfirmed.
venues.review: A small Tripadvisor sample includes praise for staff and parties (2025–26), and one February 2025 report of a very busy half-term visit. Too few reviews for a confident overall judgement.

photo.author: Christine Johnstone
photo.alt: Goyt Mill reflected in the Macclesfield Canal
photo.note: Exterior/location photograph, not an image of the play facility.

venues.priceNote: Published standard admission for ages 2 and 5 plus one adult; confirm booking and compulsory extras.

venues.name: The Place to Play
venues.price: Booking listings start from £1; the published FAQ does not identify the paid child and adult tariff. Non-walkers free with a paying child and adult.
venues.features: Over 12 pretend-play areas with a small café.
venues.pick: Children who enjoy shops, stories and imaginative play.
venues.caution: Not a large climbing-frame centre; cashless; front street parking limited to one hour.
venues.parent: Café; on-street parking at side/rear; baby changing confirmed; sightlines/noise unassessed
venues.access: Operator FAQ confirms sensory room and discussion of SEND requirements; specific current dedicated dates, step-free access and accessible WC unconfirmed.
venues.priceNote: The £1 minimum is not a family admission quote. Check the full amount for two children and one adult.

venues.name: Awesome Walls
venues.price: £30 family climbing for up to 3 eligible climbers (equipment included)
venues.session: 30 min instruction then stay and climb
venues.features: Roped climbing, bouldering and auto-belays in Pear Mill.
venues.pick: Older children and teens ready for a real climbing challenge.
venues.caution: The two- and five-year-old comparison does not apply. New climbers require instruction; confirm eligibility.
venues.parent: Refreshments and hangout areas; other parent facilities not assessed
venues.access: Ask the centre about individual needs and adaptive climbing
venues.review: Four August 2026 five-star Tripadvisor excerpts praise attentive instructors, including sessions for younger climbers. The excerpts are selected from high ratings, so they are not a balanced review sample.
venues.priceNote: Standard ages 2 and 5 are not eligible. £30 family climbing for up to three eligible climbers, equipment included; confirm supervision and booking.

photo.title: Entrance to Pear Mill, February 2023
photo.author: Gerald England
photo.alt: Entrance to the former Pear Mill, Bredbury
photo.note: Exterior/location photograph, not a current view of either play facility.

venues.name: Oxygen Activeplay Wilmslow
venues.price: Soft play (0–5) £5.95 per child; supervising adults free; £1.50 service fee per order.
venues.features: Toddler soft play, trampolines, sports and airbags.
venues.pick: Separate play options for younger and older children, not one shared ticket.
venues.caution: Soft play is for ages 0–5. Open play and Peaceful Play use different prices and age rules. Confirm socks and parking registration.
venues.parent: Café and seating by soft play; free parking with registration; changing/noise unassessed
venues.access: Peaceful Play 4+ advertises reduced capacity, quieter music, no strobes and eligible carer entry (£9.95 plus booking fee). Other access details unconfirmed.
venues.review: Tripadvisor reports from February–October 2026 include positive comments on activities and staff, and criticism of upkeep, crowding or costs. These cover different products and are not independent inspections.
venues.priceNote: Two eligible soft-play tickets £11.90 + £1.50 order fee = £13.40. Confirm any activity-specific sock requirements; open play is a different tariff.

venues.name: Wacky Warehouse at Barlow Croft
venues.address: Barlow Croft, Parrs Wood Entertainment Centre, East Didsbury, M20 5PG
venues.ages: Babies and younger children; check height
venues.price: £6 per child; adults and under-12-months free; term-time tots £4.50
venues.features: Pub-based indoor soft play with a tots area, slides and ball pools.
venues.pick: Low documented standard entry cost; combine with a meal if wanted.
venues.caution: Smaller-scale option than dedicated adventure parks; confirm age/height and visit length.
venues.parent: Café, free Wi-Fi and free onsite parking; seating/changing/noise unassessed
venues.access: Operator lists disabled facilities but specific access/WC details not confirmed
venues.review: Syndicated Google review excerpts include a report of refusal of admission near closing time, consistent with a last-admission policy. Not a representative review sample.
venues.priceNote: The current structured admission block says £6 per child (adults free); older promotional wording says from £5.50. £12 is the published standard two-child estimate.

venues.name: Pure Imagination
venues.price: £10 child-and-adult ticket; ONLY1ADULT code advertised when booking multiple children with one adult. Discount amount not published.
venues.features: Pretend shops, fantasy scenes and jobs in a themed indoor play world.
venues.pick: Worth leaving SK8 for make-believe rather than another climbing frame.
venues.caution: Booking-page snapshot is dated. Confirm current sessions and the one-adult discount before paying.
venues.parent: Café and operator-described visibility; nearby two-hour free parking; noise/changing unassessed
venues.access: Operator confirms wheelchair access and accessible toilet; sensory sessions unconfirmed
venues.review: Kidzdays reproduces a positive Google-rating snapshot; the sample and date distribution of original reviews were not independently checked. Not used as a comparable quality rating.
venues.priceNote: Two £10 tickets before the advertised one-adult discount; final checkout amount unconfirmed. One child aged 1–7 plus one adult £10.

venues.name: Curious Little Ones
venues.price: Child + adult £9.95; sibling 1+ £7.95; baby + adult £6.95 (0–12 months).
venues.features: Montessori-inspired wooden toys, pre-walker area, creative play and books.
venues.pick: A different pace from climbing frames, especially for babies and younger siblings.
venues.caution: Saturday listed closed. Under-one sibling prices depend on months; a single baby with one adult is £6.95. Confirm booking and opening.
venues.parent: Café, baby changing and open-plan design; parking and actual noise not assessed
venues.access: Operator confirms wheelchair access and accessible WC; quieter design is not a guarantee of low noise
venues.priceNote: Published standard admission for ages 2 and 5 plus one adult; confirm booking and compulsory extras.

venues.name: Little World for Scholars
venues.ages: Little walkers to about 5; pre-walkers with a paid ticket
venues.price: £9.95 child including adult; pre-walkers free with paying ticket
venues.features: Small themed play den where children create their own stories.
venues.pick: A different option for preschool pretend play near the town centre.
venues.caution: Pre-walkers are free with a paid ticket; a baby-only visit or extra-adult fee needs checking. Pram space is limited.
venues.parent: Operator café overlooks the play den. Visit Altrincham lists baby changing; town-centre parking rather than a confirmed dedicated car park.
venues.access: Wheelchair access and accessible toilet confirmed by operator
venues.review: Directory evidence corroborates themed role-play and practical facilities; syndicated review ratings are not a representative independently checked sample.
venues.priceNote: Two £9.95 child tickets = £19.90. One adult included; the published extra-adult tariffs differ, which does not affect this one-adult example.

venues.name: Play Factore
venues.price: Ages 2 and 5 + adult: term-time off-peak £32.15; peak £36.15–£41.15, depending on booking slot.
venues.session: 2 hours off-peak; peak 2–2.5 hours depending on booking
venues.features: Large indoor frame with a long slide, separate toddler area and optional zip wire.
venues.pick: Worth a longer journey for scale and older siblings.
venues.caution: Peak example £36.15–£41.15; off-peak £32.15. Optional zip wire and arcade cost extra. Check booking duration and age/height limits.
venues.parent: Operator FAQ advertises free parking (300 spaces) and accessible bays; independent comfort, viewing, changing and noise assessment outstanding.
venues.access: Dedicated SEN sessions advertised on first off-peak Tuesday of the month, 2–6pm, two-hour visit; adjusted music/lighting and eligible carer entry with ID. Confirm timetable and access.
venues.review: TripAdvisor and a separate syndicated Google snapshot differ in rating. No pooled rating or quality ranking: platforms, sample dates and visit types differ.
venues.priceNote: £32.15 off-peak or £36.15–£41.15 peak; weekday term-time and holiday prices differ. Confirm exact slot and optional activities.

picks: Varied play in one SK8 venue; confirm the conflicting published price.

Stay as long as you like
£18.50 for the example family, walk-in only and unlimited time.
Separate pre-walker area and baby ticket; a quieter style of play.

updates.detail: Initial desk-research guide: 15 venues; conflicting prices and incomplete review evidence marked. Not a site inspection.
Rechecked venue sources and prices; marked conflicting Wild Things and Nixon’s prices; clarified compulsory grip socks, review evidence and age limits; added personalised price estimates.

Rebuilt live finder: radio filters, instant shortlist and visible count, results directly below controls, combined play categories, clearer age-dependent tariffs, mobile layout and accessible no-JavaScript fallback.
V4: all 15 price scenarios, documented-information scores, 15 mapped postcodes, verified Christmas programme links and licensed location-photo references. No unsupported venue-quality rankings.
